name: uip-sdk
summary: UIP (Universal Inference Platform) Python SDK - two-tier unit+user isolation, inference/training/billing, model governance, file I/O and streaming. 0.32.0: base_url no longer defaults to a hard-coded host - pass base_url, set UIP_BASE_URL / UMR_BASE_URL, or fall back to localhost. 0.31: runnable examples/ in the sdist, upload_ref() cross-host file refs.
